video.prompt: Explain {{title}} using the selected source reports. Preserve evidence, uncertainty and learning objectives.

editorial.audience: 希望通过控制论和政治理论理解美国文化与制度的普通话观众；不预设美国生活经验或学术训练。
editorial.evidencePolicy: Distinguish emsenn’s theoretical concepts from established empirical findings and other authors’ positions. Use original texts and current primary evidence. Preserve disagreement; explain mechanisms and criticisms. Do not substitute another postliberal school for this framework.

branding.description: 用自然普通话和简体中文，从具体日常经验解释美国文化、制度反馈与 emsenn 的控制论后自由主义分析。
